body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{cert}}\)
body.construction: For \(p\geq3\) and fixed \(\iota\), enumerate the finite admissible input class in its prescribed deterministic order and run \(\mathfrak C(\Xi)\) on every input. Record every tri-valued status and its receipt, propagate the directed-rounding Taylor models and recursive Poisson tails through wrong-graph exclusion, one-sided remote-pair certification, local chart injectivity, Jacobian nonsingularity, covariance inversion, and designated-contrast precision, and retain as frontier candidates only nondominated inputs whose status is \(\mathtt{CERTIFIED}\). Inputs with status \(\mathtt{REFUTED}\) or \(\mathtt{UNDECIDED}\) remain recorded and are not promoted to certified designs.
